name: The Slow Mosaic
prompt: Arrange square sushi plates on a field of small independent turntables. Cooks nudge them from one disc to the next, gradually assembling an immense edible fish pattern. Diners at a single missing corner eat the image as it arrives.

name: Lunch by Funicular
prompt: Run a steep pair of vermilion counters between a rice kitchen and a tea terrace. Little lacquer trays ascend as diners' empty trays descend on a shared cable. One chef hooks on a fresh tray beside the big wooden wheel.

name: The Seaweed Loom
prompt: Build a broad counter threaded with long ribbons of dark nori. Cooks at opposite sides wrap rice parcels as they pass on woven bamboo slats. Finished rolls disappear into tiny private booths tucked between the reels.

name: Orbit of the Ginger
prompt: Lay three eccentric porcelain rings around a pink ginger island. Plates cross from ring to ring where the tracks briefly touch. Seated diners rotate their own little sections by pedal, causing a bright scatter of dishes to circulate.

name: The Rice Clock
prompt: Set a single long minute hand above a circular cypress dining counter. A chef rides its outer end serving one small plate at each place. The counter's empty half holds a fan of differently coloured fish waiting on crushed ice.
